papers.model: Salted KF estimation with guard saltation matrix Ξ_g for uncertain guards
papers.evidence: guard 위치 불확실성과 reset 파라미터 불확실성을 1차로 공분산에 주입...uaSKF; examples 탄성공, plastic impact, ASLIP hopper (estimation theory)

papers.title: Trajectory sensitivity analysis of hybrid systems with sliding motion
papers.model: Index-2 DAE trajectory-sensitivity theory for sliding hybrid systems
papers.evidence: sliding motion 있는 hybrid system의 trajectory sensitivity를 index-2 DAE 틀에서 엄밀히 정립; 시뮬/실험 없음(저자 명시) (sensitivity theory, no vehicle, no numerical example)

papers.title: Saltation Matrices: The Essential Tool for Linearizing Hybrid Dynamical Systems
papers.model: Survey/tutorial on saltation matrix Ξ for hybrid linearization
papers.evidence: saltation matrix Ξ에 대한 서베이+튜토리얼; 독자 실험은 없고(서베이)...covariance/Riccati 갱신 (tutorial, generic hybrid-systems tool)

papers.title: Feasibility-Guided Safety-Aware Model Predictive Control for Jump Markov Linear Systems
papers.model: Jump Markov Linear System MPC; generic LTI per-mode, consensus-horizon
papers.evidence: JMLS: xₜ₊₁ = A_{i(t)}xₜ + B_{i(t)}uₜ...M모드 각각에 trajectory 변수; examples spacecraft CWH rendezvous(6D) + hexacopter(12D) (generic LTI/JMLS algorithm, no attitude rigid-body model)

papers.title: Robustifying Model-Based Locomotion by Zero-order Stochastic Nonlinear Model Predictive Control with Guard Saltation Matrix
papers.model: Stochastic NMPC for legged locomotion (full-centroidal) with guard saltation covariance
papers.evidence: 보행로봇의 접촉 불확실성을 stochastic/robust NMPC의 covariance 전파에...full-centroidal NMPC 적용; platforms Tachyon 3 wheeled-legged, EVAL-03 humanoid (locomotion NMPC method, not a fixed-DoF vehicle)

papers.title: Constrained Trajectory Optimization for Hybrid Dynamical Systems
papers.model: Hybrid iLQR (HiLQR) + DBaS/AL constraint handling; sole example 2D bouncing ball
papers.evidence: 실험이 단일 toy(2D bouncing ball)뿐...2D bouncing ball(4상태, 2모드 ż≷0, e=0.75) 단일 시스템 (method paper but only worked example is explicitly 2D)

papers.title: Sequential Convex Programming for 6-DoF Powered Descent Guidance with Continuous-time Compound State-Triggered Constraints
papers.model: 6-DoF rocket x=(m,r_I,v_I,q_{B←I},ω_B); gimbaled-engine PDG
papers.evidence: 6-DoF 로켓: x=(m, r_I, v_I, q_{B←I}, ω_B), u=(T, δ_e, φ_e, δ_b, φ_b)...quaternion + 각속도 ω_B

papers.title: Path Integral Particle Filtering for Hybrid Systems via Saltation Matrices
papers.model: Path-integral particle-filter state estimation on hybrid systems via saltation
papers.evidence: 하이브리드 시스템의 상태추정을...path integral particle filter(PIPF)로; examples bouncing ball(2상태), SLIP(flight 5D↔stance 4D) (estimation/filtering theory, not control of a vehicle)

papers.title: Cautious Model Predictive Control Using Gaussian Process Regression
papers.model: Generic GP-residual NMPC method; states x,u + GP disturbance, PRS tightening
papers.evidence: Method paper; central examples are AUV depth control sim and a 1:43 RC autonomous-racing car (model predictive contouring), not a fixed rocket/spacecraft. Contribution is the GP-MPC + dynamic-sparse-GP algorithm/real-time impl, not a vehicle.

papers.title: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
papers.model: Online conformal-prediction wrapper; single scalar α_t tracking, no vehicle dynamics
papers.evidence: Pure distribution-free conformal-inference theory ('shift = single-parameter tracking'); experiments are stock-volatility and 2020 election county data. No dynamics integrated.

papers.title: Data-Driven MPC for Quadrotors
papers.model: 13-state rigid-body quadrotor + GP aero residual, motor-level full-state MPC
papers.evidence: Review: '명목 6-DoF 강체, RK4 이산화' and 'GP 잔차를 모터입력 레벨 full-state MPC에 tightly 통합(가상입력 bodyrate 아님)'; 13-state nominal model.

papers.title: Uniform Error and Posterior Variance Bounds for Gaussian Process Regression with Application to Safe Control
papers.model: GP-regression error/variance bound theory; safe-control demo on a robot manipulator
papers.evidence: Contribution is computable GP uniform error bound (|f−ν_N|≤β·σ_N+γ) and posterior-variance bound; worked control example is a robot manipulator tracking, not a fixed-dimension vehicle. Generic GP safe-control theory.

papers.title: A real-time GP based MPC for quadcopters with unknown disturbances
papers.model: Hover-linearized quadcopter model + 3 SS-GP latent force/moment disturbances
papers.evidence: Review: '쿼드 선형모델(hover 선형화)' augmented with 3 GPs; disturbances treated as 'latent force/moment'. Hover-linearized quad (attitude included); but model is linearized — hence lower confidence.

papers.title: Gaussian Process Uniform Error Bounds with Unknown Hyperparameters for Safety-Critical Applications
papers.model: Robust GP uniform error-bound theory under unknown hyperparameters; manipulator backstepping demo
papers.evidence: Contribution is a hyperparameter-robust GP error bound (length-scale monotonicity); validated on UCI regression and a strict-feedback manipulator backstepping example. GP safe-learning theory, not a vehicle.

papers.title: Neural-Fly enables rapid learning for agile flight in strong winds
papers.authors: O'Connell, Shi, Shi, Azizzadenesheli, Anandkumar, Yue, Chung
papers.model: Euler-Lagrange rigid-body quadrotor + learned aero residual φ·a, adaptive control
papers.evidence: Review: control law u_NF=M q̈_r+C q̇_r+g−Ks−φâ over Euler-Lagrange quadrotor; ISS-ball stability on the full rigid-body model. Limitation notes it is 'Euler-Lagrange(쿼드로터)에 특화'.

papers.title: Multihierarchy Gaussian Process Models for Probabilistic Aerodynamic Databases using Uncertain Nominal and Off-Nominal Configuration Data
papers.model: Multifidelity GP mixture for aerodynamic-coefficient database (C_L/C_D/C_m); no integrated dynamics
papers.evidence: Builds aerodatabase as nominal+correction GP mixture f=f₀+ΣwᵢΔfᵢ for Orion CM wind-tunnel coefficients; outputs trim-α/drag distributions, not a propagated trajectory. Static-coefficient GP modeling, not a vehicle dynamics model.

papers.title: Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability
papers.model: Non-exchangeable conformal coverage theory (weighted quantile + swap); coverage-gap bound
papers.evidence: Distribution-free conformal-prediction theorem (coverage gap ≤ Σw̃ᵢ·d_TV); experiments are i.i.d./changepoint/drift synthetic + ELEC2/election data. No dynamics.

papers.title: Conformal PID Control for Time Series Prediction
papers.model: Time-series conformal-prediction framework (P/I/D quantile control); long-run coverage
papers.evidence: Recasts time-series conformal as PID on the prediction-set quantile; experiments are COVID/electricity/stock/temperature forecasting. 'PID control' is a metaphor for set calibration, not vehicle control.

papers.title: Sharp Calibrated Gaussian Processes
papers.model: GP recalibration theory (two GPs, lengthscale re-optimized for sharp quantiles)
papers.evidence: Replaces variance with a separately-trained calibration GP for finite-sample calibrated quantiles; validated on 1D toy + 7 UCI regression datasets. UQ/calibration theory, no dynamics.

papers.title: Safety-Critical Control with Uncertainty Quantification using Adaptive Conformal Prediction
papers.model: ACP→probabilistic-CBF chance-margin method; toy single-integrator/unicycle robots
papers.evidence: Review: 'single/unicycle integrator 장난감 동역학 ... R=0'. Contribution is the ACP+CBF chance hand-off algorithm demonstrated on generic planar integrator/unicycle collision avoidance, not a specific vehicle.

papers.title: Efficient Zero-Order Robust Optimization for Real-Time Model Predictive Control with acados
papers.authors: Frey, Gao, Messerer, Lahr, Zeilinger, Diehl
papers.model: zoRO tube-NMPC solver/implementation (covariance propagated outside OCP, backoff injected)
papers.evidence: Review: 'algorithm 신규성 0, 엔지니어링 신규성 높음' — an acados/BLASFEO C implementation of zoRO; examples are a chain-of-masses benchmark and a differential-drive robot. Generic robust-NMPC solver paper.

papers.title: Gaussian processes for dynamics learning in model predictive control
papers.model: Survey of GP-based stochastic NMPC (scalability/propagation/closed-loop safety)
papers.evidence: Self-contained survey of GP-MPC; '서베이라 자체 실험 없음'. Reviews methods across robotics/process applications, no single vehicle dynamics model.

papers.title: Learning for Predictive Control: A Dual Gaussian Process Approach
papers.model: Outer-loop translational (position) MPC + dual-GP residual; inner-loop PD for attitude
papers.evidence: Review: 'quadrotor helix tracking ... 외부루프(병진) MPC+내부루프 PD'. The optimized MPC model is the translational (point-mass) outer loop; attitude handled by an inner PD loop, so the dynamics integrated/optimized are 3-DoF translational.

papers.title: Atmospheric-Density-Compensating Model Predictive Control for Targeted Reentry of Drag-Modulated Spacecraft
papers.model: Linear (Schweighart-Sedwick) translational relative-motion model, 4 states + EKF density
papers.evidence: Review: 'Schweighart-Sedwick J2-포함 선형모델 (cross-track 비제어라 제거→4상태)'; drag-modulated (no thrust, only C_b), a_d=ρv²C_b. Translational point-mass relative motion only — no attitude/torque states.

papers.title: Inherently Robust Suboptimal MPC for Autonomous Racing With Anytime Feasible SQP
papers.model: Planar racing-car (single-track) MPC: position + heading on track
papers.evidence: Real vehicle worked example (Kyosho Mini-Z 1:28, VICON+EKF, 30Hz); '차량모델·비용·트랙 명시', track lap periodic trajectory x_f(t) — planar x,y,yaw ground vehicle, no attitude/inertia states. Contribution is FSQP robustness analysis but the dynamics integrated is the planar car model.

papers.title: Code Generation and Conic Constraints for Model-Predictive Control on Microcontrollers with Conic-TinyMPC
papers.model: ADMM conic-MPC solver + C++ codegen; LTI/SOC generic, multiple example vehicles
papers.evidence: Solver/codegen paper — contribution is SOC closed-form projection in ADMM + dependency-free codegen, not a vehicle. Examples are disparate (safety filter QP n<=32, Crazyflie hover, rocket soft-landing SOCP n=6 m=3); '실 MCU 실측+풋프린트로 C7 최상단'. Tied to the solver, not a fixed vehicle dimensionality.

papers.title: Practical Considerations for Implementing Robust-to-Early Termination Model Predictive Control
papers.model: Anytime MPC method (discrete-time REAP, dynamic KKT-sigma); generic LTI + polytope
papers.evidence: '선형시스템·polytope 제약 한정. (1)은 LTI, (3)는 convex polytope.' Contribution is the discrete-time REAP gradient-flow safety condition (Theorems 1-3); central example is a 6-state linear drone position-control (point-mass) but the paper is a generic LTI/polytope method, not a fixed vehicle.

papers.title: Clarabel: An Interior-Point Solver for Conic Programs with Quadratic Objectives
papers.model: General-purpose conic IPM solver (quadratic-objective homogeneous embedding)
papers.evidence: 'Clarabel은 범용 데스크톱 솔버'. Benchmarks are standard solver corpora (Maros-Meszaros, SuiteSparse, optimal-control set, NETLIB, CBLIB, SDPLIB) — no fixed vehicle; contribution is the IPM algorithm/implementation.

papers.title: QOCO: A Quadratic Objective Conic Optimizer with Custom Solver Generation
papers.model: Conic (SOCP) C solver + custom codegen; quadratic-objective PDIPM
papers.evidence: Solver + codegen paper; contribution is C implementation + QOCOGEN custom linear algebra. Benchmarks are 5 problem classes (robust-KF, group-lasso, LCvx powered-descent, portfolio, oscillating-mass) + 64 MPC + Maros-Meszaros — algorithm not tied to one vehicle; '알고리즘 신규성 없음(Clarabel 복제+C패키징)'.

papers.title: Customized Interior-Point Methods Solver for Embedded Real-Time Convex Optimization
papers.model: Embedded conic-IPM solver + loop-based codegen; quadratic-objective homogeneous embedding
papers.evidence: Solver/codegen paper — contribution is infeasibility-certifying C-codegen IPM (Algorithm 1, NT-scaling, loop-based linear algebra). Examples (Mars powered-descent LCvx SOCP, quadcopter MPC) are demos of the solver; '알고리즘 신규성 없음(조합·이식)'. Not tied to a fixed vehicle dimensionality.

papers.title: Turbulence for extraterrestrial aviation: Gust specification for Dragonfly's powered flights
papers.model: Wind gust stochastic process: AR(1)/OU time series + Dryden shaping, σ RSS
papers.evidence: Pure wind/turbulence disturbance specification, not a vehicle dynamics model. Review opens '※ 사양·데이터 논문(알고리즘 아님)'. Core model is the wind stochastic process: '식4: U_g[n]=exp(−kδ)·U_g[n−1]+(2kδ)^0.5·σ_g·N(0,1) — 1차 자기회귀(AR(1)) = 지수상관 = 이산화된 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck' plus σ_g RSS (식3) and discrete cosine gust (식5). No vehicle states integrated — falls under disturbance/turbulence model = N/A.

papers.title: L4acados: Learning-Based Models for acados, Applied to Gaussian Process-Based Predictive Control
papers.model: acados solver-interface framework for learning-based (NN/GP) residual models + zero-order GP-MPC
papers.evidence: Software/solver-interface framework (external-sensitivity injection into acados SQP); worked examples are 1:24 and full-scale racing/lane-change cars — contribution is the implementation, not a fixed vehicle.

papers.evidence: Distribution-free conformal-prediction method for endogenous distribution shift; 2–3 agent sim, LSTM predictor, abstract ego dynamics — UQ theory, not a vehicle.
